scope: Verified 2026-08-13 literature and open-artifact audit for real flower replacement
summary: The audit separates runnable proposal models from sensing-gated and paper-only methods and selects an explicit multi-stem/robot/contact state with bounded neural appearance residual.
evidence: Public revisions, weights, licenses and custom-input paths were verified for DA3, MoGe-2, MegaSaM, CARI4D, V-DPM, SpatialTrackerV2, VideoManip, GMR, dex-retargeting, TrackDLO/MultiDLO, PhysTwin, DeformMaster, Wan and VACE.
C2Dex, CHOIR, ObjRetarget, HOWTransfer, Human2Humanoid, X-Humanoid, H2R-Grounder, PGRD, ContactFlow and LongDPM lack executable artifacts required by this task.
The selected architecture uses V-DPM/SpatialTracker proposals, persistent multi-rod state, exact G1/Sharpa retargeting, coupled pad/rod force and source-locked rendering.
The complete audit, novelty matrix, ranked architecture and immutable gates are recorded in docs/FLOWER_LATEST_OPEN_MODELS_20260813.md.
lessons: No single latest model changes the information-theoretic boundary of a monocular RGB clip.
Open project pages must not be treated as runnable code or weights.
limitations: The audit does not supply the missing original-scene metric observation.
Several conceptually strong 2026 methods remain paper-only.
next_actions: Run pinned V-DPM and SpatialTrackerV2 proposals when their checkpoints are available, then compare them under one optimizer.
